name: Buzzbox 323
summary: Wizbang Cranktoggle’s field research reaches Buzzbox 323, the third stop along Darkshore’s coast. You gather six Moonstalker fangs and place them in the machine north of Auberdine.

sections.title: A Slurred Transmission
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle’s voice crackles through the speaker after you operate Buzzbox 411 farther south. Heavy drinking muddles his directions, but he points you north of Auberdine, to Buzzbox 323 near a road bridge. His research calls for six Moonstalker fangs from the fierce hunters roaming Darkshore’s forests.

sections.title: Gnomish Field Machinery
sections.body: Buzzbox 323 chatters with static and faint muttering before you begin. Place the requested fangs in its intake hopper, and the machine rattles violently, grinding the teeth into dust. Wizbang’s boozy voice returns through the transceiver to celebrate your delivery and point you toward the next machine in his scattered network.

faq.answer: Buzzbox 323 sits beside the main road north of Auberdine, near the bridge over the local river in Darkshore.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the Buzzbox?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome inventor elsewhere in Darkshore, speaks through the remote transmitters while drinking ale.

faq.q: What does Buzzbox 323 do with the fangs?
faq.answer: Place the Moonstalker fangs inside, and Buzzbox 323’s gears grind them into fine powder for Wizbang’s automated biological sampling.

faq.q: Where can I find Moonstalkers in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Moonstalkers and their runts prowl the shaded woodlands and hills along the road north and south of Auberdine.

faq.q: What quest comes before and after Buzzbox 323?
faq.answer: Buzzbox 323 follows Buzzbox 411, where you gathered thresher eyes, and comes before Buzzbox 525, which sends you south along the road to collect grizzled scalps from thistle bears.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang sound so incoherent?
faq.answer: Wizbang is thoroughly intoxicated as he gives directions, pausing to search for his ale and taking loud gulps between sentences.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can hear Wizbang’s remote voice network at work, an example of gnomish engineering flair despite his poor personal discipline.
As a night elf, you know the fierce Moonstalkers call for reverent caution. Gnomish science grinds their lethal fangs to dust.
As an engineer, you can see how the Buzzboxes combine automated material processing with long-range voice relay, despite their rough operation.
